limitations: Neutral clearing size uses mean building tiles across all home and neutral meadows; no neutral-only numeric telemetry is exported. This dilutes the intended effect and is not a direct neutral-area measurement.
Worker telemetry is averaged across colonies. Matching its mean cannot establish each colony has the requested count.

Paired seeds hold inputs constant except one control, but generation retries may choose different landscapes. Per-seed reversals can occur; these are observed effects, not a fixed-geometry intervention.
Size/team/worker envelope coverage is not the Cartesian product of every control combination. Random sampling does not prove universal reliability.

random_worker_check.precision: mean across colonies only; individual counts cannot be verified

envelope_worker_check.precision: mean across colonies only; individual counts cannot be verified
